name: K8 Wireless Microphone
description:
ABS material
Built-in 75 mAh battery (Included)
Type-C charging port
Real-time crystal voice syncs without any delay

Description
K8 wireless microphone comes with ABS material. It is a built-in 75 mAh battery. This microphone's endurance is 5 hours. It features plug and play, a collar clip design, and noise reduction. Its wireless transmission distance is 20m. This is an ideal choice for YouTube / Facebook Live Stream, Bloggers, YouTubers, Interviewers, and other video recording lovers.
